run_DPR_retriever: run the DPR class to retrieve top Wikipedia documents for a batch of queries using dense retrieval
init_DPR_from_config: create a DPR retriever instance from an OmegaConf config file with a given name
process_query_DPR: process a query dict by stripping entity tokens and appending a question mark if needed
feed_data_DPR: feed a list of query dicts into the DPR retriever to prepare questions and query IDs
review_DPR_run_provenance: review the DPR run method that returns a provenance dict mapping query IDs to ranked documents
